I cried myself to sleep, whispering. I anyone one even out there, But then you showed up. You smiled, and suddenly the world wasn't so dark. I felt seen, understood. Remember that silly dance in the kitchen with the burnt pancakes. Oh, we were a mess. But now, now you're gone. The silence is deafening. I miss you. Every single day. But I carry you with me in every laugh, every tear, every quiet moment. And I'll keep going because that's what you'd want always.😔
